head: codex/202-authorized-learner-transport-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b1.5] Extend authenticated Raft transport to governed learners
body:
Closes #202

## Summary

- add factory-owned authenticated learner transport with distinct durable voter and learner authority instances
- enforce boot custody, peer pins, pending exclusion, recovery identity, target membership, deadlines, and cache-first exact retry
- preserve the exact three-voter cut while a real fourth PolisRaft receives snapshot and append traffic over governed Quinn
- repair hosted coverage routing for the transport subtree and reinstall rotated routes after intentional authority-cut drain

## Validation

- immutable v9 receipt: 36 semantic cases, 42 private runner tests, 13 public tests, 31 named assertions
- three integration compile lanes, exact route-rotation regression, coverage-impact contract, strict library and public Clippy
- fresh independent exact-head review PASS with no P0-P3 findings

## CI boundary

Use the standard hosted required checks with one large runner allocation for this issue; optional jobs remain disabled.
